title: The Jaguar Type 01 market
intro: Jaguar registered 16,617 new cars in the UK in 2024, 1,725 in 2025 while it sold off old stock, and 8 in January to October 2026. The Type 01, its first car after the 2024 rebrand, was revealed in October 2026 from £129,950; orders open in early 2027 and first deliveries are promised for the second half of the year. Jaguar has not published a sales target, and it now has 19 UK dealerships, down from about 90. This market resolves in January 2028 on a public web page, and your team name will appear there: pick one you are happy to see in public.
